interpretation: One starting actor/fine-tuning seed and two maps: exploratory, not universal or statistically significant. Adaptive is compared with equal-budget continuation; old v10 and v5 are baselines. 16s primary and 64s secondary remain separate; secondary cannot override primary failure. Posture means are conditional on visited valid states, not matched-state causal effects. Ideal ray depth and a kinematic swing proxy do not establish real-camera or robot safety.
